COMPARISON ANALYSIS

Small-commercial time-of-use with demand charge vs All-electric commercial space-heating plan

Both are commercial rate structures, but they behave very differently. Small-commercial time-of-use with demand charge is best for shave peak, while All-electric commercial space-heating plan favors rightsize plan.

Feature Small-commercial time-of-use with demand charge All-electric commercial space-heating plan
Rate StructureTOU DEMANDTOU
Peak Window16:00-21:00 weekdays06:00-09:00 weekdays Nov-Mar
Demand Charge BandMIDLOW
Fixed Charge BandMIDMID
Primary Action LeverSHAVE PEAKRIGHTSIZE PLAN
Common MisreadOwners shift load into off-peak hours but restart everything at once, resetting the peak.Owners assume a heat-labelled rate is automatically cheaper for their load shape.

🎯 The Verdict

If your business has high, concentrated usage during peak hours, All-electric commercial space-heating plan will likely save you money. Always verify your specific load profile before requesting a rate change from your utility.
